bestiary.eclipse.deckhand.behavior: Hunting: rows in silence and does not fight until roused — then it comes off the bench swinging its oar in short, brutal arcs. Grounds: the ghost ship from day one; during the final toll the Ferryman calls fresh crews to the deck.
bestiary.eclipse.deckhand.lore: Mute rowers of the ghost ship. They pulled us through the black water once, and they will keep rowing long after we are gone. They never look up — pray they never do.
bestiary.eclipse.deckhand.name: Deckhand
bestiary.eclipse.deckhand.weakness: While it rows it cannot be harmed — the bench is its sanctuary and blades pass through it. It only becomes flesh when it rises to fight; cut it down then. During the Ferryman's toll, felling the crew is the only way to drag him back off his knee.
bestiary.eclipse.drift_lantern.behavior: Habits: drifts the limbo ferry lane in a slow, aimless bob — it never hunts, never flees, never strays from the route. Grounds: the buoy lane of the dead sea, kept at a loose handful of lights at all times.
bestiary.eclipse.drift_lantern.lore: Soul-flames caged in glass, adrift above the dead sea. They light nothing and lead nowhere — yet the ferry route is never without them. Break one and the dark feels a little more personal.
bestiary.eclipse.drift_lantern.name: Drift Lantern
bestiary.eclipse.drift_lantern.weakness: It has no defenses at all: one solid strike shatters the cage and the soul-flame gutters out into glowstone dust. The only cost is the dark it leaves behind.
bestiary.eclipse.eclipse_cultist.behavio: Hunting: holds an eight-to-fourteen-block band, rooting for a one-second chant before releasing a three-bolt shadow fan that curves back in late. Grounds: the vaults beneath the new land from day nine; the Rift Warden calls more of them mid-fight.
bestiary.eclipse.eclipse_cultist.lore: They wore the hooded uniform before you did — by choice. Rune pages orbit the left hand, a knife waits in the right, and the chant under the hood never quite stops. The vaults below are theirs to keep.
bestiary.eclipse.eclipse_cultist.name: Eclipse Cultist
bestiary.eclipse.eclipse_cultist.weaknes: Every cast roots it for the chant, and the fan spreads twelve degrees per bolt — strafe through a gap or make it waste the volley on a pillar. Rushed, it has only a panic knife and a backpedal: close the band, and the caster becomes a coward with a letter opener.
bestiary.eclipse.ferryman.behavior: Hunting: three movements at the helm — sweeping oar arcs and gunwale slams, a kneeling toll while his deckhand crew boards, and a lantern gaze that hunts the weakest heart aboard. Grounds: the ship of the last day; he sails on day fourteen.
bestiary.eclipse.ferryman.lore: He rows the drowned to the far shore and takes his toll in souls. On the last day the ship sails again — pay him in defiance, and everyone comes home.
bestiary.eclipse.ferryman.name: The Ferryman
bestiary.eclipse.ferryman.weakness: His oar sweeps only the half-circle BEFORE him — the safe footing is at his back and flanks. While he kneels for the toll he cannot be touched: fell the crew to force him back to his feet. And stay out of the black water; it collects by the second.
bestiary.eclipse.fog_colossus.behavior: Hunting: advances like a landslide — unhurried, unstoppable, immune to any shove — and raises both fists once someone strays within five blocks. Grounds: the heart of mature fog storms from day nine; one per storm, rarely more in the world.
bestiary.eclipse.fog_colossus.lore: Cracked stone shoulders overgrown with fog-coral, knuckles the size of doors. It is slow the way a landslide is slow. When it raises both fists, the ground is about to stop being yours.
bestiary.eclipse.fog_colossus.name: Fog Colossus
bestiary.eclipse.fog_colossus.weakness: The slam is announced a full second before it lands, and the shockwave HUGS THE GROUND: beyond three blocks from the fists, a well-timed jump clears it entirely. Inside those three blocks there is no dodge at all. Keep your feet ready and your distance honest, and the mountain never touches you.
bestiary.eclipse.fog_revenant.behavior: Hunting: drifts the storm scars in a slow phase-glide, shrugging off shoves and falls, closing until it can root itself and channel. Grounds: fog storms at night from day six, a handful per storm.
bestiary.eclipse.fog_revenant.lore: What the fog keeps, it remakes. A robe with no body drifts the storm scars, coral of grey mist growing from its shoulder. When the wisps flare, close your eyes — you will lose them anyway.
bestiary.eclipse.fog_revenant.name: Fog Revenant
bestiary.eclipse.fog_revenant.weakness: Its blinding burst is announced: the claws rise and the wisps flare through a rooted second-and-a-half channel, and the pulse only reaches five blocks. Step back — or break its line of sight — during the flare and the cast is wasted; a revenant that cannot blind you is just a slow robe.
bestiary.eclipse.fog_tyrant.behavior: Hunting: a court in three acts — cleaver work and telegraphed fog-lances, then a living crown of lightning and blinding squalls, finally a desperate barrage of storm-steps with a colossus called to court. It howls its hound pack back to strength throughout. Grounds: the crowned storm lair from day twelve.
bestiary.eclipse.fog_tyrant.lore: When a storm grows old enough, it grows a king. A mountain of wet slate crowned in living fog, a caged heart of lightning in its chest. It drinks its own banks to heal — stand inside the fog and deny it.
bestiary.eclipse.fog_tyrant.name: Fog Tyrant
bestiary.eclipse.fog_tyrant.weakness: Every death it deals is announced first. Lance lines glitter along their EXACT path for a breath — one sidestep or any wall defeats them. The crown's lightning strikes only its marked rings; walk off them. And the blinding squall takes ONLY those holding line of sight — duck behind cover at the rising howl and keep your eyes.
bestiary.eclipse.gazer.behavior: Habits: keeps to the rim of your torchlight from night three onward, drifting to wherever you are not quite looking; it never attacks, it only watches. Grounds: the night around any wanderer — there is always at most one, and it is always yours.
bestiary.eclipse.gazer.lore: A hooded shape at the edge of the torchlight. It only watches. Meet its gaze and it is gone — but never far, and never for long.
bestiary.eclipse.gazer.name: Gazer
bestiary.eclipse.gazer.weakness: It cannot be slain: meet its gaze or strike it and it merely scatters into the dark — never far, and never for long. What can be worn down is its mystery; every sighting survived writes another line onto this page.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_hound.behavior: Hunting: closing distance is its whole design — a frame-skip blink of up to four blocks every six to ten seconds, then a pounce across the last stretch. Grounds: freshly grown rings from day eight, hunting alongside the husks.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_hound.lore: A hunter stitched from misplaced frames — its stride skips, its jaw arrives before the head. Fresh ground remembers being nothing, and sends these to argue you off it.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_hound.name: Glitched Hound
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_hound.weakness: Every trick it has closes distance; none of them protect it. The pounce is committed the moment it leaves the ground — step aside and cut it down as it lands, before the next skipped frame.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_husk.behavior: Hunting: shambles openly while watched, blinks a few blocks sideways every ten seconds or so, and sprints the moment your back is turned. Grounds: freshly grown rings from day eight, mostly after dark.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_husk.lore: The new land came back wrong, and so did this. A shape like a man, split along seams that bleed light, half its face one step behind the rest. Do not wait for it to finish loading.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_husk.name: Glitched Husk
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_husk.weakness: Its speed is stolen from your blind spot — it moves half again as fast only while you are NOT looking at it. Walk backwards and keep it on screen: watched, it is just a slow shambler with a long reach. The static burst behind you is the only warning you get.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_tick.behavior: Hunting: boils out of unstable ground in threes and swarms the nearest pair of ankles; a landed bite clamps on and gnaws once a second. Grounds: freshly grown rings from day eight, wherever the world has not yet decided to stay.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_tick.lore: Shard-mites that boil out of unstable ground in threes. Each is nothing; the swarm is a countdown. Where they skitter, the world has not yet decided to stay.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_tick.name: Glitched Tick
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_tick.weakness: A latched mite lets go the instant you strike it — one swat with anything and it pops off. Two quick paces of distance shake it just as well. Each is a nuisance; the countdown only kills the one who ignores it.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_wanderer.behav: Hunting: paces toward you at corridor speed and stops a dozen steps out, staring. Every time you look away it is closer. Grounds: the Backrooms, exclusively — it cannot leave. Neither should you believe it won't try.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_wanderer.lore: Someone else no-clipped in long before you did, and the yellow soaked all the way through. It walks the corridors like it is looking for the exit. It is not looking for the exit.
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_wanderer.name: Wanderer
bestiary.eclipse.glitched_wanderer.weakn: Watched, it is furniture — it only closes distance in your blind spot. Back down the corridors with it on screen and it never touches you. Whatever you do, do not let it stand behind you for long.
bestiary.eclipse.herald.behavior: Hunting: fights in three movements — homing shard volleys, a marking gaze, and a collapsing pull — and never leaves its arena. Grounds: descends on day seven to weigh the settlement; there is only ever the one.
bestiary.eclipse.herald.lore: A broken godhead of black glass and corona shards, sent ahead of the eclipse to weigh us. Its core is the key the altar hungers for.
bestiary.eclipse.herald.name: The Herald of the Eclipse
bestiary.eclipse.herald.weakness: Anything thrown from outside its arena is deflected — this fight happens inside or not at all. When its eye fixes you, the mark dies with the view: put stone between you before it tolls. In the collapse, run against the pull; the rings burn where you would be dragged.
bestiary.eclipse.pale_sentinel.behavior: Hunting: utterly still under any gaze; every unwatched moment is a fast, silent stride closer. It burrows away at daybreak. Grounds: the pale garden at night from day ten — the outer plains ring suffers at most a few.
bestiary.eclipse.pale_sentinel.lore: The pale trees keep one gardener. It stands utterly still while watched — root-claw hands folded, ember eyes patient. Every glance away is a stride you will not hear. Keep looking. Keep walking backwards.
bestiary.eclipse.pale_sentinel.name: Pale Sentinel
bestiary.eclipse.pale_sentinel.weakness: Its bark hardens under observation: while frozen it takes only HALF damage — but a statue cannot swing back. Keep every eye on it and grind it down in perfect safety; the halved blade is slow, but the unwatched stride is lethal. Never trade full damage for a glance away.
bestiary.eclipse.rift_warden.behavior: Hunting: a duelist's rhythm — blade sweeps, homing shadow volleys, and a rift-step that re-renders it behind you, chimes tolling at the landing spot. Grounds: the deep vault dungeons from day ten; it grows with the number who walk in.
bestiary.eclipse.rift_warden.lore: Half a knight in polished obsidian; the other half is a wound in the world, and the wound holds the swords. It steps out of itself to stand behind you. Listen for the chimes — they toll where it lands.
bestiary.eclipse.rift_warden.name: Rift Warden
bestiary.eclipse.rift_warden.weakness: Wounded below half, every volley costs it: the rift gutters and the knight stands ROOTED for two seconds, taking half again more damage — that stagger is where the fight is won. Trust your ears over your eyes: the chimes always toll where the blink will land. Outside its ring your arrows bounce; step in or stay home.
bestiary.eclipse.storm_hound.behavior: Hunting: runs in packs of two or three out of the storm wall, announced by a low howl; it crouches, charges up, and lunges down a dead-straight line. Grounds: fog storms at night from day six, whelped fresh as the storm needs them.
bestiary.eclipse.storm_hound.lore: Pack hunters whelped inside the fog storms, spines crackling with stolen lightning. The howl is a courtesy; the charge is not. Step aside at the last breath and it staggers — that is your whole opening.
bestiary.eclipse.storm_hound.name: Storm Hound
bestiary.eclipse.storm_hound.weakness: The lunge is locked the instant the crouch ends — a single sidestep dodges the entire line. If it misses or slams a wall, the hound stands sparking and helpless for two full seconds. That stagger is the kill window; take it every time.
bestiary.eclipse.the_other.behavior: Hunting: wears our uniform on pale nights and walks like one of us, drifting closer until it is within arm's reach — then it stops pretending. Grounds: pale nights from day four; gone without a trace by dawn.
bestiary.eclipse.the_other.lore: On pale nights it walks among us wearing our uniform. It moves like a friend, stops like a friend, stares like nothing human. Check the eyes before you turn your back.
bestiary.eclipse.the_other.name: The Other
bestiary.eclipse.the_other.weakness: It needs closeness to kill: keep any 'friend' you cannot name at more than arm's length on pale nights and it never gets its opening. It cannot outlive the dawn — survive the night, and the night takes it back.
bestiary.eclipse.umbral_stalker.behavior: Hunting: circles in packs of three or four — one growls to pin your attention while the others flank, and wounding one brings the whole pack in leaping. Grounds: the open night from day five; umbral nights drive them out in force.
bestiary.eclipse.umbral_stalker.lore: Obsidian-furred pack hunters with shards of violet light along the spine. Where one growls, three more circle. Dawn is your only ally.
bestiary.eclipse.umbral_stalker.name: Umbral Stalker
bestiary.eclipse.umbral_stalker.weakness: The pack is its strength and its leash: they break and scatter at first light, so a defensible corner held until dawn routs them all. Their spring is committed the moment they jump — a sidestep leaves them landing on empty ground.
bestiary.eclipse.wizard_orin.behavior: Habits: keeps to his mountain observatory, charting the eclipse; he hunts nothing and nothing hunts him. Grounds: the observatory on the highest peak — he is learned by visiting, not by the blade.
bestiary.eclipse.wizard_orin.lore: A hermit astronomer who watched the eclipse arrive from the highest summit and decided to take notes instead of fleeing. He will distill a sun-core catalyst for anyone who brings him shards — and call down the very stars on anyone who tries to take it. He is always back the next day. The mountain does not let him leave.
bestiary.eclipse.wizard_orin.name: Orin the Sun-Reader
bestiary.eclipse.wizard_orin.weakness: He is an old man, not a monster — he has no defenses worth the name. His Sun-Core Catalyst can be EARNED through his errand, or torn once from his corpse; the corpse gives no second counsel and brews no second favor. The only thing you can truly lose here is him.

collection.eclipse.item.arm_artifact: Your permanent interface to the Eclipse, locked to the last hotbar slot. Right-click opens the logbook: missions, collections, bestiary and more.
collection.eclipse.item.compass_of_watch: The needle follows the nearest other player, refreshed every few seconds. It shows the way — never the name.
collection.eclipse.item.eclipse_wand: Soulbinds to its first holder. Choose one of three paths — the choice is final — then cast its powers with Veilladung that regrows fastest at night.
collection.eclipse.item.ferryman_toll: The Ferryman's guaranteed drop and the finale's trophy: fare for a crossing no one returns from. Nothing consumes it — yet.
collection.eclipse.item.fog_cloak_trim: A single cut from the Fog Tyrant's mantle — one keepsake per kill, nothing more and nothing less.
collection.eclipse.item.fog_core: A guaranteed trophy from the Fog Tyrant: the storm itself, knotted small and still.
collection.eclipse.item.glitch_shard: A splinter shed by glitched creatures. Crafting reagent — a glitch recipe condenses it toward a Vitae Shard.
collection.eclipse.item.grave_dowser: Its needle remembers where you fell: it always points to your nearest own grave.
collection.eclipse.item.heart_extractor: Hold use to tear out one of your own lives in exchange for two Heart Fragments. It refuses your last life. Survives four uses.
collection.eclipse.item.heart_fragment: Left behind when a life is given up at the altar or torn out by the extractor. Reagent for the Revive Sigil.
collection.eclipse.item.herald_core: The Herald's guaranteed drop. Required to raise the altar to milestone IV — one core plus sixteen ender pearls.
collection.eclipse.item.heralds_lure: Sneak-use on the altar after dusk to call the Herald down onto the sanctum. Crafted from 4 umbral shards and a heart fragment.
collection.eclipse.item.revive_sigil: Consumed at the altar to begin the revive ritual — it carves a banned player's name back into the world.
collection.eclipse.item.storm_heart: The Fog Tyrant's beating heart, a guaranteed drop — the trophy of a broken storm.
collection.eclipse.item.umbral_blade: A diamond-class blade that drinks: a player kill returns one extra life to you on top of the kill's own heart, capped at seven. It cannot be repaired.
collection.eclipse.item.umbral_pick: A diamond-class pick that bites 50% faster under the open night sky. It cannot be repaired.
collection.eclipse.item.umbral_shard: Loot of the night creatures and the altar's coin: sneak-right-click the altar to bank shards, then spend them in the shard shop and on summoning crafts.
collection.eclipse.item.vitae_shard: Hold use to crush it: one permanent extra life takes root in you, up to the ceiling of seven.
collection.eclipse.item.wizard_catalyst: The Sun-Core Catalyst, the crafting gate of the Zauberstab. Earned once from Orin's errand (8 amethyst shards + 1 umbral shard) — or taken from his corpse.

dev.eclipse.doc.backrooms.lockout.clear: Clears Backrooms re-entry lockouts for one player or all players.
dev.eclipse.doc.backrooms.portal: Places the Backrooms entry portal at your position, or removes it.

dev.eclipse.doc.backrooms.tp: Teleports you onto one of the five Backrooms levels (yellow/pool/warehouse/flooded/hollow).
dev.eclipse.doc.backroomsleave: Player command: leave the Backrooms voluntarily (asks for confirmation; locks this instance).
dev.eclipse.doc.backroomsscare: The ghost arc, but it ends in a blackout 'clip' INTO the backrooms for 20-30 s: the player cannot die there, ANY damage glitches them straight home, and the return position survives relogs and server stops

dev.eclipse.doc.dev.reload: Hot-reload all configs and re-sync clients

dev.eclipse.doc.display.clear: Deletes every tracked display entity, including entities in currently unloaded chunks.
dev.eclipse.doc.display.give: Gives the op-only Display Wand. Hold a block in the off hand; right-click to place/select, sneak-right-click to delete. Axiom is unavailable for NeoForge 1.21.1.
dev.eclipse.doc.display.list: Lists every persisted vanilla block display and its animation parameters.
dev.eclipse.doc.display.param: Edits one display's rotation axis/speed, bob, scale, glow or position, or deletes it.
dev.eclipse.doc.dome.arm: Arm the mansion glitch dome at the real landmark, or 'arm here [radius]' for a transient test dome at your feet
dev.eclipse.doc.dome.destroy: Run the full destruction sequence from the first beat (loot, shatter, aftershocks)
dev.eclipse.doc.dome.hits: Set the emitter's remaining melee hits (0..8; 0 starts the destruction)
dev.eclipse.doc.dome.reset: Rewind the dome to ACTIVE: fresh device and zone, shards swept, schedule cleared
dev.eclipse.doc.dome.shatter: Play only the BlockDisplay shard show — at the dome if armed, else above you (FX iteration)
dev.eclipse.doc.dome.status: Dome state: status byte, geometry, remaining hits, zone/device ids, aftershock schedule
dev.eclipse.doc.eclipse.bestiary.reset: Clears the persisted bestiary knowledge (encounters, sighting/kill counters) of one player — of EVERYONE when the selector is omitted.
dev.eclipse.doc.end_event: Ends the credits from ANY beat — designed as the release of the post-finale black HOLD: players un-hidden, un-frozen, faded back in and returned to the overworld spawn; HUD/FOV/sky handed back; completion persisted.
dev.eclipse.doc.enderchestsee: Opens a LIVE view of another player's ender chest; changes apply instantly.
dev.eclipse.doc.event.start.endarrival: F-077: runs the ~50 s 'the altar summons the End' cinematic. Without arguments this is the REAL day-12 path (the End disc materializes at the phase-3 boundary); 'fxonly' replays the identical show without writing a single block.
dev.eclipse.doc.event.start.herold: Run the Herald's full arrival cutscene (sky veil + horn, light column, ground break, camera pull, materialisation) and the summon it ends on — the same sequence the day-7 lure fires. Plays over the sanctum altar; add 'here' to stage it at your feet instead
dev.eclipse.doc.event.stop.endarrival: Aborts the running End arrival cinematic: block-display debris is discarded and guided cameras are released. World state already committed (a started disc build) keeps running.
dev.eclipse.doc.event.stormtouched: Sets/clears the persisted stormTouched flag. ON grants the arm artifact to everyone immediately; OFF purges it again until the storm is touched.
dev.eclipse.doc.ferryman.skipto: Skips the shore theater and arms the crossing directly: everyone ships to the limbo deck — countdown, transformation, arena fight.
dev.eclipse.doc.ferryman.status: Shows the finale stage, the accumulated orbit debris, the portal site and whether the arena fight runs.
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.caption: Show a cinematic caption on your client in the given style (subtitle, title or whisper).
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.cutscene.play: Play a cutscene for ALL players: global teleport gather, view-distance bump, return after.
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.cutscene.preview: Trace a cutscene flight path with particles (arc-length spaced; no camera takeover).
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.cutscene.stop: Abort every active cutscene session (unfreeze + return gathered players).
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.emitter: Spawn a Quasar emitter on your client, at your feet or at the given position.
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.post: Force an Eclipse Veil post pipeline on/off on your client, or list live pipelines.
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.rift: Open a rift tear FX at a position with the given width; 'rift close' closes your last one.
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.sequence: Replay one phase of a scripted sequence in FX-only mode (no world/state changes).
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.storm: Spawn/dissipate a dev storm wall or vortex at your position, or fire a lightning bolt where you look.
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.sun.debug: Toggle the sun-debug HUD cross at the CPU-projected sun point (compare against the disc).
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.supplybeam: Toggle a test supply-beam marker at your position (add on first run, remove on second).
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.uniform: Override one float uniform of a Veil post pipeline on your client (debug knob).
dev.eclipse.doc.fx.viewdist: Push a cinematic view distance to your client, or reset the server+client bump.
dev.eclipse.doc.ghostscreen: Play the ~10 s ghost arc on a player: a ghost overlay materializes, glitch text, escalating glitch post-FX and ONE very loud bang. Purely client-side — only the target sees and hears anything
dev.eclipse.doc.glitch.add: Spawn a silent glitch zone: effect, radius (blocks), duration (s); defaults to your position/dimension, optional x y z and fade-out ticks
dev.eclipse.doc.glitch.altar: Fire the ambient altar glitch now — a purple void zone on the sanctum altar whose impulse radiates from the altar block; 'status' prints the schedule instead
dev.eclipse.doc.glitch.color: Repaint a LIVE glitch zone (purple, green, red, cyan, orange, white, pink, or 'default'); the accent slides on every client inside it
dev.eclipse.doc.glitch.list: List live glitch zones: effect, radius, dimension, centre, remaining time, id
dev.eclipse.doc.glitch.remove: Remove one glitch zone by its id (tab-completes live ids)
dev.eclipse.doc.glitch.test: Preview a glitch effect on yourself only (default 10 s), no zone is created
dev.eclipse.doc.invsee: Opens a LIVE view of another player's inventory (36 inventory + armor + offhand); changes apply instantly.
dev.eclipse.doc.jumpscare: Play one of the 30 jumpscare scripts on a player (version tab-completes; 'list' shows all). Each version is a distinct client-side script — overlays, post-FX, sound design, timing. Nobody but the target perceives it
dev.eclipse.doc.jumpscare.list: List all 30 jumpscare versions with a one-line description of each
dev.eclipse.doc.limbo.pvp: Allows or forbids player-vs-player damage in Limbo (persisted, OFF by default). An active boss fight lifts the block on its own.
dev.eclipse.doc.limbo.status: Shows the effective Limbo house rules: build lock and PvP state, including a boss fight currently lifting the PvP block.
dev.eclipse.doc.lives.give: Grant or remove Lives for ONE player through the standard pipeline (negative removes; capped at 7 Lives, hitting 0 engages the ghost flow).
dev.eclipse.doc.lives.status: Show Lives and ghost state for one player or everyone online.
dev.eclipse.doc.minigame.portal: Relocates the minigame portal to your position or removes it.
dev.eclipse.doc.minigame.start: Opens a minigame event (arena or race), builds the course and spawns the entry portal near spawn.
dev.eclipse.doc.minigame.status: Shows minigame phase, remaining time, course state, participants, open inventory tickets and the portal.
dev.eclipse.doc.minigame.stop: Ends the minigame event: graceful 10-second close, or immediately with 'now'.
dev.eclipse.doc.minigame.time: Extends, shortens or sets the minigame window (e.g. 10m, 1h10m, 90s).
dev.eclipse.doc.minigameleave: Leaves the current minigame after a confirmation click — inventory restored, re-entry stays open.

dev.eclipse.doc.phase.daily: Switch the day/phase cadence back to once per real day at the configured boundary time (persisted in realtime.json).
dev.eclipse.doc.phase.interval: Switch the day/phase cadence to a recurring real-time interval, e.g. a new phase every 2 hours (persisted in realtime.json).
dev.eclipse.doc.phase.next: Skip to the next phase immediately: a full day rollover with signals, bell, and announcements; the clock re-anchors on the active cadence.
dev.eclipse.doc.phase.status: Show the phase cadence mode, current event day, next boundary, and remaining time.
dev.eclipse.doc.photon.status: Photon layer health: bridge guard chain, live-executor budget, loop cache and every registered PhotonFxRegistry cue row (client-side report)

dev.eclipse.doc.player.multiplier.clear: Reset a player's hidden skill-XP multiplier to 1.

dev.eclipse.doc.player.multiplier.show: Show a player's hidden skill-XP multiplier to the issuing operator.

dev.eclipse.doc.player.xp.give: Grant skill XP through the normal multiplier and cap pipeline.

dev.eclipse.doc.portal.list: Lists all registered portal-event variants with rarity weights.
dev.eclipse.doc.portal.open: Opens the named portal event through the variant scheduler (xbox, backrooms, …).

dev.eclipse.doc.quest.reroll: Reroll a player's personal quest set.
dev.eclipse.doc.quest.revoke: Revoke any current main, side, or personal quest by id.

dev.eclipse.doc.replay.list: Lists replayable FX-only sequence ids and phases registered by the cutscene engine.

dev.eclipse.doc.skin.set: Override a player's skin from a link: direct PNG (64x64 or 64x32 legacy), NameMC profile, Mojang texture URL, or a plain Minecraft name
dev.eclipse.doc.spawn.census: Prints per-category mob-cap usage and the Y-band spawn-attempt counters of your current dimension (B5 diagnostic); 'reset' clears the counters.

dev.eclipse.doc.spawn.show: Shows both protection radii and draws/toggles an op-only particle preview.

dev.eclipse.doc.start_ferryman: Runs the WHOLE ferryman finale in the 15 s dev cut: portal formation (seeds a test debris swarm on a young world) → key → door → teleport → arena fight.
dev.eclipse.doc.stats.query: Query one player's analytics for a metric/day or list all non-zero metrics.
dev.eclipse.doc.stats.top: Show the current-day top ten for an analytics metric.
dev.eclipse.doc.status: Show a compact health dashboard for the live Eclipse event.
dev.eclipse.doc.structure.configured: Place a REGISTRY structure (minecraft:village_plains, minecraft:ancient_city, any datapack structure) — generated, then grounded through the landmark pipeline
dev.eclipse.doc.structure.list: List the placeable ids of both lanes; an optional filter matches anywhere in the id

dev.eclipse.doc.timer.resume: Resume the paused real-time day countdown.
dev.eclipse.doc.timer.set: Set the next boundary by wall time, date-time, or relative duration.
dev.eclipse.doc.timer.status: Show detailed zone-aware real-time day clock status.

dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.1: The sky is a ledger, friend, and the eclipse is a debt come due. I have read its columns for forty years from this very summit.
dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.2: Look up. The dark disc does not devour the sun — it borrows it. And what is borrowed must be returned... or taken back by force.
dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.3: Every falling star is a word the night forgot. My telescope catches a few. The rest land out there, in the dark, waiting to be picked up.
dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.4: You carry my sun-core well. When the last night comes, point it at the sky and remind it who the light belongs to.
dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.challenge_h: You want the heart of a veil wand? A sun-core is not distilled, friend — it is WON. Raise your hand against me, and the stars will weigh what you are worth.
dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.challenge_t: You took my sun-core with your own two hands. The stars keep that entry in their ledger — and so, friend, do I.
dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.provoked: So you choose the taking. Then let me show you what I have READ in the stars!
dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.quest_alrea: You already took your sun-core from me, friend, with your own two hands. One core, one victory — the stars keep no second entry.
dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.quest_done: So it is done — won as it must be, star against steel. One sun-core catalyst. Spend it on something bright.
dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.quest_hint: You want a sun-core catalyst, friend? It is not distilled and it is not traded — it is WON. Raise your hand against me, and the stars will weigh what you are worth.
dialogue.eclipse.wizard_orin.unveil: Enough courtesy! Forty years I have READ the sun — now let it answer for me!

echo.eclipse.memory.0: The tree was already old when we were small. 'Catch me then,' she called — I can still hear it.
echo.eclipse.memory.1: Every morning I waved to her from the adit. The rock gave silver. It never gave the hours back.
echo.eclipse.memory.2: On this bench we said nothing until the sun went down. It was the finest conversation of my life.

gui.eclipse.altar.boss.ferryman.body: Day 14 — the last crossing. Every dawn, the rift has fed the dark orbit above the island; on the final day the debris descends and builds a portal gate upon the water. A great key then hangs above the altar. Touch it: it flies to the gate, the door breaks open, and the violet takes everyone aboard his ship — now an arena. Survive his oar, his waves, his harvest of souls; heed every violet warning on the deck. Bring food, healing and ranged weapons — the fallen fight on as ghosts.

gui.eclipse.altar.boss.ferryman_done.bod: The toll was paid with defiance — the Ferryman is beaten and the Eclipse recedes.
gui.eclipse.altar.boss.herald.body: From day 7: craft a Herald's Lure (4 umbral shards + 1 heart fragment) and sneak-use it on the altar after dusk. First it circles and hurls homing shard volleys — cut down the Umbral Stalkers it calls. When its gaze locks onto you (heartbeat, purple haze), break line of sight behind a sanctum pillar before it fires. At the end it drags everyone inward — jump the expanding soul-flame rings. Stay inside the arena ring; shots from outside are deflected. It drops the Herald Core the altar hungers for.

gui.eclipse.artifact.rules.line1: 1. Every player has a limited number of lives. When your last life is lost, your soul is banned from the world until other players revive you at the altar.
gui.eclipse.artifact.rules.line10: 10. Admin decisions are final. Report issues on the event Discord instead of arguing in game.
gui.eclipse.artifact.rules.line2: 2. Everyone is anonymous: chat, name tags, the tab list, signs, books and anvil naming are sealed. Speak only through the proximity voice chat.
gui.eclipse.artifact.rules.line3: 3. The event runs in days. Each day brings three goals, new unlocks and a larger world border. Check this menu every day.
gui.eclipse.artifact.rules.line4: 4. Parts of your inventory, workstations, dimensions and entire mods stay sealed until the matching day or altar milestone unlocks them.
gui.eclipse.artifact.rules.line5: 5. The altar accepts offerings. Completing a milestone raises the altar level and unlocks new powers for everybody.
gui.eclipse.artifact.rules.line6: 6. Heart fragments come from the crafted Heart Extractor (2 hearts → 4 fragments), never from the altar; they are an ingredient for reviving banished players.
gui.eclipse.artifact.rules.line7: 7. Graves protect a fallen player's items for a grace period. Do not touch a fresh grave that is not yours.
gui.eclipse.artifact.rules.line8: 8. The arm artifact is bound to you: it sits sealed in the top-right inventory slot and cannot be dropped, stored or moved. Right-click it (or press J) to open this ledger.
gui.eclipse.artifact.rules.line9: 9. Teaming, alliances and betrayal are allowed — griefing spawn and exploiting bugs are not.

wand.eclipse.power.glut.1.desc: A fire dart up to 12 blocks: the first creature on the ray takes ~2.5 hearts and burns for 3 s.
wand.eclipse.power.glut.2.desc: A flame ring rolls out around you to 12 blocks: ~3.5 hearts, 3 s of fire and a knock-up — it never sets the world itself alight.
wand.eclipse.power.glut.3.desc: A fiery leap forward and up; the landing slams for ~3 hearts in a 4-block radius and ignites for 2 s.
wand.eclipse.power.glut.4.desc: The greater fire wave: an 18-block ring, ~5 hearts, 4 s of fire and a stronger knock-up.
wand.eclipse.power.glut.5.desc: The higher magma leap: a farther arc, ~5 hearts on landing in a 6-block radius, 3 s of fire.
wand.eclipse.power.riss.1.desc: A short glitch teleport: steps you up to 12 blocks along your gaze and cancels your fall.
wand.eclipse.power.riss.2.desc: De-rezzes a cone of blocks ahead of you (up to 24) for ~10 s, then the world re-knits block by block. Chests, the altar and protected ground never vanish.
wand.eclipse.power.riss.3.desc: Opens a maw at the aimed point up to 24 blocks out: ~4 hearts and knockback in a 4-block radius before the tear snaps shut.
wand.eclipse.power.riss.4.desc: The wider phase wave: a longer cone (up to 40 blocks) held ~12 s before the world re-knits.
wand.eclipse.power.riss.5.desc: The greater maw: ~7 hearts and harder knockback in a 6-block radius, reaching 32 blocks out.
wand.eclipse.power.stern.1.desc: Calls a single star down on the aimed point up to 32 blocks out: ~2.5 hearts in a 2-block radius.
wand.eclipse.power.stern.2.desc: Marks a zone (8-block radius, ~1.5 s warning), then 12 stars rain down for ~2.5 hearts each.
wand.eclipse.power.stern.3.desc: After a short telegraph one great comet falls: ~6 hearts and heavy knockback in a 5-block radius.
wand.eclipse.power.stern.4.desc: The greater shower: 20 stars over a 10-block zone, ~3 hearts each.
wand.eclipse.power.stern.5.desc: The greater comet: ~9 hearts and brutal knockback in a 7-block radius, with barely a heartbeat of warning.

wand.eclipse.screen.later: ESC — let the branch sleep a while longer
wand.eclipse.screen.riss.lore: Where the world tears, you walk. Space bends inward — and obeys.

wand.eclipse.screen.stern.lore: The sky keeps its promises. Bind, shield, and let the stars judge.
wand.eclipse.screen.stern.tag: Storm and cosmos. Call sparks, showers of stars, one great comet.
wand.eclipse.screen.title: The wand awakens
wand.eclipse.spell.glut.aschesturm.desc: Smothers the aimed zone (6-block radius) in choking ash for 3 s: heat pulses of ~1.5 hearts, 2 s ignitions and slowed silhouettes.
wand.eclipse.spell.glut.eruptionslinie.d: Five staggered ground eruptions march 14 blocks away from you: ~4 hearts each in a 2.5-block radius, knock-up and 3 s of fire. Herds enemies or cuts off a retreat.
wand.eclipse.spell.glut.feuerball.desc: Hurls an ember sphere up to 28 blocks that detonates on the first thing it meets: ~4.5 hearts in a 3-block blast plus 4 s of fire. No terrain damage.
wand.eclipse.spell.glut.feuerwelle.desc: A ring of flame rolls out from you to 12 blocks over ~2 s: ~4.5 hearts, knock-up and 4 s of fire — already-burning foes take 1.5×.
wand.eclipse.spell.glut.flammenfaecher.d: A burning 70° cone slap in front of you (7 blocks): ~3.5 hearts, 3 s of fire and a shove for everything in the fan.
wand.eclipse.spell.glut.glutstoss.desc: A short ember beam (12 blocks) that burns through up to 2 bodies: ~3 hearts each and 4 s of fire.
wand.eclipse.spell.glut.inferno.desc: The capstone: a firestorm holds the aimed zone (9-block radius) for 7 s while ten eruptions rain down — ~3.5 hearts each, knock-up and 4 s of fire.
wand.eclipse.spell.glut.magmasprung.desc: A fiery leap forward and up; the landing slams for ~4 hearts in a 4.5-block radius and ignites for 2 s. The leap wraps you in 5 s of fire resistance.
You rise on burning wings: a fire nova below hits for ~5 hearts in 6 blocks (4 s of fire, hard knockback), while you glide down on 6 s of slow falling with 5 s of fire resistance.
wand.eclipse.spell.glut.sonnenkern.desc: A captured piece of sun crashes onto the aimed point (up to 32 blocks) after a ~1.2 s telegraph: ~11 hearts in a 6-block radius, 5 s of fire, and everything is hurled away.
wand.eclipse.spell.riss.blink.desc: A short glitch teleport: steps you up to 16 blocks along your gaze and cancels your fall. For ~1.5 s after arrival your half-knitted body takes far less damage.
wand.eclipse.spell.riss.echoklinge.desc: Three phase-blade pulses slice around you in a rapid beat — ~2.5 hearts each to everything within 4.5 blocks. Cast it mid-run: the echoes follow you.
wand.eclipse.spell.riss.ereignishorizont: The capstone: a standing horizon (8-block radius) holds for 6 s, endlessly pulling and pulsing ~2 hearts — then it collapses: ~7 hearts and a violent shove outward.
wand.eclipse.spell.riss.gravitationsbrun: Plants a standing well (7-block radius, 4 s) at the aimed point: it constantly drags enemies inward and pulses ~1.5 hearts every second. Area denial that gathers its own targets.
wand.eclipse.spell.riss.leerensog.desc: One violent void maelstrom at the aimed point: a 9-block drag, then the crunch — ~6 hearts and a 4 s slow for everything caught in it.
wand.eclipse.spell.riss.phasentausch.des: Swaps your place with the first creature on your look ray (up to 20 blocks). The shock costs it ~2 hearts; you re-knit with ~1.5 s of damage resistance.
wand.eclipse.spell.riss.rissschlag.desc: Tears a maw into space at the aimed point (up to 24 blocks): it inhales everything nearby for ~1.2 s, then snaps shut for ~5 hearts and hard knockback in a 4.5-block radius.
wand.eclipse.spell.riss.schattenriss.des: Steps you through the veil BEHIND a target (up to 20 blocks) and rends its back for ~7 hearts plus a 3 s slow. Arrival grants ~2 s of damage resistance.
wand.eclipse.spell.riss.umbra_lanze.desc: A piercing void beam that punches through everything in a 24-block line for ~4 hearts. At its endpoint the dark collapses: a small implosion drags victims in for ~2.5 more hearts and slows them. Touches no terrain.
wand.eclipse.spell.riss.zugfeld.desc: Collapses a 6-block field onto its center: everything living is yanked inward, dazed for ~2 hearts and slowed for 3 s.
wand.eclipse.spell.stern.funkenruf.desc: Calls a guiding star bolt onto the aimed point (up to 32 blocks): ~3 hearts in a small radius and a 5 s mark that makes the victim glow through walls.
The capstone: seven comets hammer the aimed zone (9-block radius, up to 32 blocks) for ~5 hearts each — then the verdict falls: one zone-wide pulse of ~8 hearts. Marked targets take 1.5×.
wand.eclipse.spell.stern.kometenschlag.d: Calls a comet onto the aimed point (up to 32 blocks) after a 1 s telegraph: ~8 hearts and brutal knockback in a 5-block radius — marked targets take 1.25×.
wand.eclipse.spell.stern.lichtsegen.desc: Healing starlight over you and every ally within 6 blocks: ~3 hearts restored at once, then 8 s of regeneration and 8 s of speed.
wand.eclipse.spell.stern.novawaechter.de: An orbiting guardian star watches over you for 6 s: every second it smites the nearest threat within 8 blocks for ~3 hearts and marks it.
wand.eclipse.spell.stern.spiegelpanzer.d: Mirror-hard skin for 8 s (resistance II) that ignites with a repulse nova: ~3 hearts in 5 blocks, hard knockback, and everything struck is marked.
wand.eclipse.spell.stern.sternenbann.des: A wide binding seal on the aimed zone (10-block radius, up to 28 blocks): ~2.5 hearts, 5 s of rooting, 6 s of weakness and a 7 s mark for everything inside.
wand.eclipse.spell.stern.sternenschild.d: Weaves a shell of starlight around you: 2 golden absorption hearts for 15 s plus 12 s of damage resistance.
wand.eclipse.spell.stern.sternschauer.de: After a short telegraph, 14 star shards rain over the aimed zone (8-block radius) for 3 s: ~3 hearts each plus a slow — marked targets take 1.25×.
wand.eclipse.spell.stern.wurzelgriff.des: Star-light roots burst from the aimed ground (up to 24 blocks, 4.5-block radius): everything is pinned in place for ~3.5 s, takes ~2 hearts and is marked for 5 s.
